profile.headline: Software Engineer 2 @ Microsoft | M365 Copilot | Jackie Robinson Foundation Alum 💫
profile.summary: Hi I'm Sedrick! I'm currently a Software Engineer 2 @ Microsoft. I work alongside engineers, data scientists, and senior leaders to drive performance optimizations across our LLM Fleet that powers M365 Copilot. I'm very passionate about building products at scale, driving system improvements via automation, and leveraging agentic tooling for accelerated planning, development, and analysis.

positions.description: Developing performance and benchmarking tools for the latest LLM models from OpenAI, measuring improvements and regressions to ensure quality before shipping on M365 Copilot worldwide.

projects.title: BiT (Business Intelligence Tool) - Capstone Project
projects.description: Created and deployed a Business Intelligence web app that visualizes club data from CampusGroups (Attendance, Budgeting, Forecasting, etc.). Used Django for backend/frontend, ChartsJs for visualizations and deployed using Heroku.

projects.title: Machine Learning with Spotify Songs
projects.description: Built and trained multiple machine learning models including a SVM on 1,000+ of my liked and disliked songs on Spotify using audio features from the Spotify API. It can predict new songs with 82% accuracy via the SVM model (Support Vector Machine).

organizations.name: Jackie Robinson Foundation Scholar
organizations.description: The JRF scholarship is awarded to outstanding high school graduates who plan to earn a baccalaureate degree from an accredited, four-year college or university. This four-year program guides JRF Scholars to effectively navigate their college environments, explore career options, develop leadership skills, and embrace a commitment to service.
